author: driver
content:
Additional use cases that fall out of this same table — captured here so we don't fork a new issue:

- Group view across (zen_generation, socket→Ryzen/EPYC platform, type_id) joining blob_strings against entries+images. Aggregate sources per cell: list of (image_id, vendor, model, bios_version, blob_sha256).
- Superset / orphan / maximum-element relationships within a cell are pure SQL — no new module needed.
- Format-string-only specialisation (string_type='format'): same queries with an extra WHERE. Format strings are the highest-signal markers for debug-build vs release because they're compiler-generated.
- Useful CLI surface once the table exists: `psp-etl strings compare --gen zen5 --type 0x02 [--format-strings-only] [--explain BLOB]`.
- Ryzen/EPYC distinction: today images.socket only sees AM4/AM5 (consumer); EPYC SP3/SP5 isn't scraped yet. The analysis works on whatever images exist; extending the corpus to EPYC is orthogonal.
